Art, Spirituality and Science for a New Consciousness.
Art, Spirituality and Science for a New Era of Consciousness
en.O Instituto Civitas Solis é uma organiza: The Civitas Solis Institute is a philosophical-cultural, non-profit organization dedicated to integral human development through the study and practice of humanity's perennial knowledge.
en.Fundado com o propósito de promover a sí: Founded to promote the synthesis of science, art and spirituality, our institute seeks to contribute to the awakening of a new planetary consciousness based on ancestral wisdom and contemporary discoveries.
en.Através de publicações, palestras, works: Through publications, lectures, workshops and cultural projects, we work to disseminate knowledge capable of positively transforming people's lives and society as a whole.
en.Cultivamos a expressão artística como fo: We cultivate artistic expression as a way to awaken beauty, sensitivity and symbolic perception of human experience.
en.Promovemos o desenvolvimento espiritual: We promote spiritual development through the study of universal philosophical traditions and the search for inner meaning.
en.Exploramos as fronteiras do conhecimento: We explore the frontiers of scientific knowledge, integrating modern discoveries with ancestral wisdom.
en.Construímos pontes entre culturas, tradi: We build bridges between cultures, traditions and forms of knowledge.
en.Estabelecemos cooperações para ampliar o: We establish cooperation to expand the reach of cultural and philosophical projects.
en.Desenvolvemos iniciativas que integram c: We develop initiatives that integrate knowledge, sensitivity and inner transformation.
en.Temos a honra de manter uma parceria est: We are honored to maintain a strategic partnership with Embassy of the Free Mind, an international organization dedicated to preserving and disseminating the Hermetic tradition and Western esoteric knowledge. This collaboration allows us to expand our reach and impact, connecting with a global network of researchers, philosophers and seekers of truth.

Hello, Civitas Solis Institute. I would like to contact you about...

My phone number for return contact is:
en.Ex.: Parcerias, dúvidas, eventos ou publ: E.g.: Partnerships, questions, events or publications
en.Descreva o motivo do contato e inclua se: Describe the reason for contact and include your phone number in the message body to make follow-up easier.
en.Nossa missão transcende fronteiras geogr: Our mission transcends geographical and cultural boundaries, connecting hearts and minds in search of a unified planetary consciousness.
en.Fomentar o desenvolvimento humano integr: To internationally foster integral human development in its material, emotional, rational and spiritual aspects, individually through self-development and collectively through culture, promoting dialogue and an open space for encounter.
en.Tornar-se referência cultural por meio d: To become a reference in the national landscape and begin internationalization through activities that foster the integral development of the human being, individually and collectively. To be an attracting hub for specialists and opinion leaders in an open dialogue between different views, aiming at constructive collaboration.
en.Nosso trabalho global se manifesta atrav: Our global work takes shape through several initiatives that seek to promote the evolution of human consciousness on a planetary scale:
en.O Instituto Civitas Solis reconhece que: The Civitas Solis Institute recognizes that humanity's contemporary challenges are global in nature and require solutions that transcend traditional divisions between nations, cultures and spiritual traditions. Our work is grounded in the understanding that there is an underlying unity connecting all beings and that true social transformation can only occur through the awakening of this universal consciousness.
en.Através de publicações multilíngues, con: Through multilingual publications, international conferences, transformational workshops and digital platforms, we reach people on every continent, offering practical tools for personal development and positive social transformation.
en.Através de uma abordagem integral que ho: Through an integral approach that honors both cultural diversity and the universal principles of perennial wisdom, we work to build bridges between East and West, tradition and modernity, science and spirituality.
en.Facilitamos o intercâmbio de conheciment: We facilitate the exchange of knowledge between different cultural and spiritual traditions, promoting interreligious and intercultural dialogue.
en.Desenvolvemos programas educacionais que: We develop educational programs that integrate intellectual knowledge, emotional development and spiritual growth.
en.Nosso trabalho global já tocou a vida de: Our global work has already touched the lives of thousands of people in dozens of countries, contributing to the awakening of a new generation of conscious leaders and agents of transformation. We see growing evidence that a new planetary consciousness is emerging, one that recognizes the fundamental interconnection of all life and the urgent need for global cooperation.
en.Olhando para o futuro, continuamos expan: Looking to the future, we continue expanding our network of international partners, developing new educational technologies and creating increasingly inclusive spaces for dialogue between different wisdom traditions. Our vision is of a world where perennial wisdom informs global decisions and authentic spirituality is recognized as fundamental to the well-being of humanity and the planet.
en.Esta parceria exemplifica nosso compromi: This partnership exemplifies our commitment to international cooperation in the field of philosophical and spiritual studies. Together, we develop research projects, educational events and publications that contribute to a deeper understanding of humanity's wisdom traditions.
en.Explora os padrões energéticos mediante: Explores the energetic patterns through which all forms were created on the basis of unity (J. Zatón)
en.Explora um livro de doze especialistas q: Explores a book by twelve specialists who tell, like a great mosaic, the story of Western Gnosis
en.Movimento cristão ascético (1100–1200),: Ascetic Christian movement (1100-1200), influenced by Paulicians and Bogomils.
en.Entrevistas realizadas pelo Instituto Ci: Interviews conducted by the Civitas Solis Institute on various topics with many guests.
en.Redescobrindo os Mistérios Herméticos qu: Rediscovering the Hermetic Mysteries that Transformed the World
en.Uma jornada fascinante através dos conhe: A fascinating journey through the secret knowledge that influenced the great masters of the Renaissance, revealing how Hermetic wisdom shaped our modern civilization.
en.Este não é apenas um livro de história,: This is not just a history book, but an invitation to reflect on how perennial knowledge can inform our contemporary search for meaning and transformation. An essential work for students of philosophy, art history, Western esotericism and all those interested in understanding the hidden roots of our civilization.
en.• As sociedades secretas por trás da Ren: • The secret societies behind the Renaissance
en.• Símbolos herméticos nas obras de arte: • Hermetic symbols in works of art
en.Mergulhe nos mistérios da Renascença e d: Dive into the mysteries of the Renaissance and discover the secrets that transformed the world.
en.Respeitamos a longa tradição de conhecim: We respect the long tradition of knowledge from all cultures and peoples, reaching back to humanity’s earliest times.
en.Acreditamos em relações de qualidade e c: We believe in relationships built on quality and trust. We value people’s diversity and life experiences, fostering ethical conduct and mutual care.
en.Estamos abertos ao diálogo e comunicação: We are open to dialogue and communication, seeking to bring shared interests together and exchange different perspectives.
en.A partir do autoconhecimento podemos ir: Through self-knowledge, we can discover our inner truth and purpose in life, recognizing the essence of genuine personal expression.
en.Temos energia e otimismo para fazer acon: We have the energy and optimism to make things happen and inspire thoughts, feelings and actions.
en.Motivamos no outro a vontade de seguir s: We encourage others to follow their personal journey, celebrating each person’s contribution to individual and collective achievements.
en.Somos vetores de mudanças positivas para: We are agents of positive change for the transformation of people and the world.

Ser un polo de atracción para especialistas y formadores de opinión para un diálogo abierto entre visiones distintas, orientado a la colaboración constructiva.

fr.Através de palestras, entrevistas e cont: À travers des conférences, des entretiens et des contenus éducatifs, nous cherchons à contribuer à l'éveil d'une nouvelle conscience planétaire, fondée sur la sagesse ancestrale et les découvertes contemporaines.
fr.Através de publicações, palestras, works: À travers des publications, des conférences, des ateliers et des projets culturels, nous travaillons à diffuser des connaissances capables de transformer positivement la vie des personnes et de la société dans son ensemble.
fr.Construímos pontes entre culturas, tradi: Nous construisons des ponts entre les cultures, les traditions et les formes de connaissance.
fr.Explore nosso canal no YouTube, dedicado: Contenus sur l'art, la spiritualité et la science pour une nouvelle conscience planétaire
fr.Cultivamos a expressão artística como fo: Nous cultivons l'expression artistique comme moyen d'éveiller la beauté, la sensibilité et la perception symbolique de l'expérience humaine.
fr.Desenvolvemos iniciativas que integram c: Nous développons des initiatives qui intègrent connaissance, sensibilité et transformation intérieure.
fr.Promovemos o desenvolvimento espiritual: Nous promouvons le développement spirituel à travers l'étude des traditions philosophiques universelles et la recherche de sens intérieur.
fr.Entrevistas realizadas pelo Instituto Ci: Entretiens réalisés par l'Institut Civitas Solis sur différents thèmes avec divers invités.
fr.Estabelecemos cooperações para ampliar o: Nous établissons des coopérations pour élargir la portée de projets culturels et philosophiques.
fr.Estamos aqui para ouvir você. Compartilh: Nous sommes là pour vous écouter. Partagez vos idées, vos questions ou votre intérêt pour nos projets.
fr.Explore nosso conteúdo mais recente sobr: Explorez nos contenus les plus récents sur la philosophie, la spiritualité et le développement humain
fr.Exploramos as fronteiras do conhecimento: Nous explorons les frontières de la connaissance scientifique, en intégrant les découvertes modernes aux sagesses ancestrales.
fr.Fundado com o propósito de promover a sí: Fondé dans le but de promouvoir la synthèse entre science, art et spiritualité, notre institut cherche à contribuer à l'éveil d'une nouvelle conscience planétaire, fondée sur la sagesse ancestrale et les découvertes contemporaines.
fr.Inscreva-se no canal e ative o sino para: Abonnez-vous à la chaîne et activez la cloche pour recevoir les notifications des nouveaux contenus
fr.O canal do YouTube do Instituto Civitas: La chaîne YouTube de l'Institut Civitas Solis est consacrée à la diffusion de connaissances sur la philosophie pérenne, les traditions spirituelles et le développement intégral de l'être humain.
fr.O Instituto Civitas Solis é uma organiza: L'Institut Civitas Solis est une organisation philosophico-culturelle à but non lucratif dédiée au développement humain intégral à travers l'étude et la pratique des connaissances pérennes de l'humanité.
fr.Temos a honra de manter uma parceria est: Nous avons l'honneur de maintenir un partenariat stratégique avec Embassy of the Free Mind, une organisation internationale dédiée à la préservation et à la diffusion de la tradition hermétique et des connaissances ésotériques occidentales. Cette collaboration nous permet d'élargir notre portée et notre impact, en nous reliant à un réseau mondial de chercheurs, de philosophes et de quêteurs de vérité.
fr.Explora os padrões energéticos mediante: Explore les motifs énergétiques par lesquels toutes les formes ont été créées à partir de l'unité (J. Zatón)
fr.Explora um livro de doze especialistas q: Explore un livre de douze spécialistes qui racontent, comme une grande mosaïque, l'histoire de la Gnose occidentale
fr.Movimento cristão ascético (1100–1200),: Mouvement chrétien ascétique (1100-1200), influencé par les pauliciens et les bogomiles.
fr.Fomentar o desenvolvimento humano integr: Favoriser internationalement le développement humain intégral dans ses aspects matériel, émotionnel, rationnel et spirituel, individuellement par l'autodéveloppement et collectivement par la culture, en promouvant le dialogue et un espace ouvert de rencontre.
fr.Tornar-se referência cultural por meio d: Devenir une référence sur la scène nationale et amorcer l'internationalisation par la réalisation d'activités favorisant le développement intégral de l'être humain, dans ses dimensions individuelle et collective. Être un pôle d'attraction pour les spécialistes et les leaders d'opinion dans un dialogue ouvert entre visions différentes, visant une collaboration constructive.

fr.Estamos abertos ao diálogo e comunicação: Nous sommes ouverts au dialogue et à la communication, cherchant à rapprocher les intérêts communs et à partager des perspectives différentes.
fr.A partir do autoconhecimento podemos ir: Grâce à la connaissance de soi, nous pouvons découvrir notre vérité intérieure et notre vocation, en reconnaissant l’essence d’une expression personnelle authentique.
fr.Temos energia e otimismo para fazer acon: Nous avons l’énergie et l’optimisme nécessaires pour agir et stimuler pensées, sentiments et attitudes.
fr.Motivamos no outro a vontade de seguir s: Nous encourageons les autres à suivre leur chemin personnel, en célébrant la contribution de chacun aux réussites individuelles et collectives.
fr.Somos vetores de mudanças positivas para: Nous sommes des acteurs de changements positifs pour la transformation des personnes et du monde.

de.Sete princípios fundamentais que guiam t: Sieben grundlegende Prinzipien leiten all unser Handeln und unsere Entscheidungen.
de.Através de publicações, palestras, works: Durch Publikationen, Vorträge, Workshops und Kulturprojekte verbreiten wir Wissen, das das Leben der Menschen und der Gesellschaft als Ganzes positiv verändern kann.
de.Construímos pontes entre culturas, tradi: Wir bauen Brücken zwischen Kulturen, Traditionen und Wissensformen.
de.Cultivamos a expressão artística como fo: Wir pflegen den künstlerischen Ausdruck als Weg, Schönheit, Sensibilität und symbolische Wahrnehmung der menschlichen Erfahrung zu wecken.
de.Desenvolvemos iniciativas que integram c: Wir entwickeln Initiativen, die Wissen, Sensibilität und innere Transformation verbinden.
de.Entrevistas realizadas pelo Instituto Ci: Interviews des Civitas Solis Instituts zu verschiedenen Themen mit unterschiedlichen Gästen.
de.Estabelecemos cooperações para ampliar o: Wir etablieren Kooperationen, um die Reichweite kultureller und philosophischer Projekte zu erweitern.
de.Exploramos as fronteiras do conhecimento: Wir erforschen die Grenzen wissenschaftlicher Erkenntnis und verbinden moderne Entdeckungen mit alten Weisheiten.
de.O Instituto Civitas Solis é uma organiza: Das Civitas Solis Institut ist eine philosophisch-kulturelle, gemeinnützige Organisation, die der ganzheitlichen menschlichen Entwicklung durch Studium und Praxis des dauerhaften Wissens der Menschheit gewidmet ist.
de.Temos a honra de manter uma parceria est: Wir haben die Ehre, eine strategische Partnerschaft mit Embassy of the Free Mind zu pflegen, einer internationalen Organisation zur Bewahrung und Verbreitung der hermetischen Tradition und westlicher esoterischer Kenntnisse. Diese Zusammenarbeit ermöglicht es uns, unsere Reichweite und Wirkung zu erweitern und uns mit einem globalen Netzwerk von Forschern, Philosophen und Wahrheitssuchenden zu verbinden.
de.Explora os padrões energéticos mediante: Erforscht die energetischen Muster, durch die alle Formen auf Grundlage der Einheit geschaffen wurden (J. Zatón)
de.Explora um livro de doze especialistas q: Erforscht ein Buch von zwölf Fachleuten, die wie ein großes Mosaik die Geschichte der westlichen Gnosis erzählen
de.Movimento cristão ascético (1100–1200),: Asketische christliche Bewegung (1100-1200), beeinflusst von Paulikianern und Bogomilen.
de.Fomentar o desenvolvimento humano integr: Die ganzheitliche menschliche Entwicklung international in ihren materiellen, emotionalen, rationalen und spirituellen Aspekten fördern, individuell durch Selbstentwicklung und kollektiv durch Kultur, mit Dialog und einem offenen Raum der Begegnung.
de.Tornar-se referência cultural por meio d: Eine Referenz auf nationaler Ebene werden und die Internationalisierung durch Aktivitäten beginnen, die die ganzheitliche Entwicklung des Menschen individuell und kollektiv fördern. Ein Anziehungspunkt für Fachleute und Meinungsbildner für einen offenen Dialog zwischen unterschiedlichen Sichtweisen mit dem Ziel konstruktiver Zusammenarbeit sein.

de.Promovemos o desenvolvimento espiritual: Wir fördern die spirituelle Entwicklung durch das Studium universeller philosophischer Traditionen und die Suche nach innerem Sinn.

de.Olá, Instituto Civitas Solis. Gostaria d:
Hello, Civitas Solis Institute. I would like to contact you about...

My phone number for return contact is:
de.Ex.: Parcerias, dúvidas, eventos ou publ: E.g.: Partnerships, questions, events or publications
de.Descreva o motivo do contato e inclua se: Describe the reason for contact and include your phone number in the message body to make follow-up easier.
de.Nossa missão transcende fronteiras geogr: Our mission transcends geographical and cultural boundaries, connecting hearts and minds in search of a unified planetary consciousness.
de.Nosso trabalho global se manifesta atrav: Our global work takes shape through several initiatives that seek to promote the evolution of human consciousness on a planetary scale:
de.O Instituto Civitas Solis reconhece que: The Civitas Solis Institute recognizes that humanity's contemporary challenges are global in nature and require solutions that transcend traditional divisions between nations, cultures and spiritual traditions. Our work is grounded in the understanding that there is an underlying unity connecting all beings and that true social transformation can only occur through the awakening of this universal consciousness.
de.Através de publicações multilíngues, con: Through multilingual publications, international conferences, transformational workshops and digital platforms, we reach people on every continent, offering practical tools for personal development and positive social transformation.
de.Através de uma abordagem integral que ho: Through an integral approach that honors both cultural diversity and the universal principles of perennial wisdom, we work to build bridges between East and West, tradition and modernity, science and spirituality.
de.Facilitamos o intercâmbio de conheciment: We facilitate the exchange of knowledge between different cultural and spiritual traditions, promoting interreligious and intercultural dialogue.
de.Desenvolvemos programas educacionais que: We develop educational programs that integrate intellectual knowledge, emotional development and spiritual growth.
de.Nosso trabalho global já tocou a vida de: Our global work has already touched the lives of thousands of people in dozens of countries, contributing to the awakening of a new generation of conscious leaders and agents of transformation. We see growing evidence that a new planetary consciousness is emerging, one that recognizes the fundamental interconnection of all life and the urgent need for global cooperation.
de.Olhando para o futuro, continuamos expan: Looking to the future, we continue expanding our network of international partners, developing new educational technologies and creating increasingly inclusive spaces for dialogue between different wisdom traditions. Our vision is of a world where perennial wisdom informs global decisions and authentic spirituality is recognized as fundamental to the well-being of humanity and the planet.
de.Esta parceria exemplifica nosso compromi: This partnership exemplifies our commitment to international cooperation in the field of philosophical and spiritual studies. Together, we develop research projects, educational events and publications that contribute to a deeper understanding of humanity's wisdom traditions.
de.Redescobrindo os Mistérios Herméticos qu: Rediscovering the Hermetic Mysteries that Transformed the World
de.Uma jornada fascinante através dos conhe: A fascinating journey through the secret knowledge that influenced the great masters of the Renaissance, revealing how Hermetic wisdom shaped our modern civilization.
de.Este não é apenas um livro de história,: This is not just a history book, but an invitation to reflect on how perennial knowledge can inform our contemporary search for meaning and transformation. An essential work for students of philosophy, art history, Western esotericism and all those interested in understanding the hidden roots of our civilization.
de.• As sociedades secretas por trás da Ren: • The secret societies behind the Renaissance
de.• Símbolos herméticos nas obras de arte: • Hermetic symbols in works of art
de.Mergulhe nos mistérios da Renascença e d: Dive into the mysteries of the Renaissance and discover the secrets that transformed the world.
de.Respeitamos a longa tradição de conhecim: Wir achten die lange Wissenstradition aller Kulturen und Völker, die bis in die frühesten Zeiten der Menschheit zurückreicht.
de.Acreditamos em relações de qualidade e c: Wir glauben an vertrauensvolle, wertvolle Beziehungen. Wir schätzen die Vielfalt der Menschen und ihrer Lebenserfahrungen und fördern ethisches Handeln und gegenseitige Fürsorge.
de.Estamos abertos ao diálogo e comunicação: Wir sind offen für Dialog und Kommunikation, um gemeinsame Interessen zusammenzuführen und unterschiedliche Sichtweisen auszutauschen.
de.A partir do autoconhecimento podemos ir: Durch Selbsterkenntnis können wir unserer inneren Wahrheit und unserem Lebenssinn begegnen und das Wesen eines authentischen persönlichen Ausdrucks erkennen.
de.Temos energia e otimismo para fazer acon: Wir haben die Energie und den Optimismus, etwas zu bewirken und Gedanken, Gefühle und Haltungen anzuregen.
de.Motivamos no outro a vontade de seguir s: Wir ermutigen andere, ihren persönlichen Weg zu gehen, und würdigen den Beitrag jedes Einzelnen zu individuellen und gemeinsamen Erfolgen.
de.Somos vetores de mudanças positivas para: Wir sind Träger positiver Veränderungen zur Wandlung der Menschen und der Welt.

it.Estabelecemos cooperações para ampliar o: Stabiliamo cooperazioni per ampliare la portata di progetti culturali e filosofici.

it.O Instituto Civitas Solis é uma organiza: L'Istituto Civitas Solis è un'organizzazione filosofico-culturale senza fini di lucro dedicata allo sviluppo umano integrale attraverso lo studio e la pratica delle conoscenze perenni dell'umanità.
it.Temos a honra de manter uma parceria est: Abbiamo l'onore di mantenere una partnership strategica con Embassy of the Free Mind, un'organizzazione internazionale dedicata alla preservazione e diffusione della tradizione ermetica e delle conoscenze esoteriche occidentali. Questa collaborazione ci permette di ampliare la nostra portata e il nostro impatto, collegandoci a una rete globale di ricercatori, filosofi e cercatori della verità.
it.Explora os padrões energéticos mediante: Esplora i modelli energetici mediante i quali tutte le forme sono state create sulla base dell'unità (J. Zatón)
it.Explora um livro de doze especialistas q: Esplora un libro di dodici specialisti che raccontano, come un grande mosaico, la storia della Gnosi Occidentale
it.Movimento cristão ascético (1100–1200),: Movimento cristiano ascetico (1100-1200), influenzato da pauliciani e bogomili.
it.Fomentar o desenvolvimento humano integr: Promuovere a livello internazionale lo sviluppo umano integrale nei suoi aspetti materiale, emotivo, razionale e spirituale, individualmente attraverso l'autosviluppo e collettivamente attraverso la cultura, promuovendo il dialogo e uno spazio aperto di incontro.
it.Tornar-se referência cultural por meio d: Diventare un riferimento nello scenario nazionale e avviare l'internazionalizzazione con attività che favoriscano lo sviluppo integrale dell'essere umano, individualmente e collettivamente. Essere un polo attrattore per specialisti e opinion leader in un dialogo aperto tra visioni diverse, orientato alla collaborazione costruttiva.
